parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID. You can call the [DescribeDnsGtmInstances](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describednsgtminstances) operation to obtain the instance ID.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description: The language of the response. Default: en. Valid values: en, zh, and ja.

parameters.name: StrategyMode
parameters.description:
The scheduling mode. Valid values:

- GEO: Geolocation-based

- LATENCY: Latency-based
